question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which of the twins' pranks was your favorite?
Have you ever pulled a prank on someone?

nodes.text: Howard opens the door.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Howard. Why are you out of breath?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, is that the smell of rotten eggs?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And why are you all wet?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And your face looks a little puffy. Are those `bee` stings?
nodes.text_bbcode: And your face looks a little puffy. Are those [color=#3b78e2][i]bee[/i][/color] stings?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just, uh, cleaning up before you got here. But I'm great. Especially now that you're here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, thanks!
$ZOE kisses Howard hello!
The twins come up to $ZOE and Howard.
Howard opens the door.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Howard. Why are you out of breath?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, is that the smell of rotten eggs?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And why are you all wet?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And your face looks a little puffy. Are those `bee` stings?
nodes.text_bbcode: And your face looks a little puffy. Are those [color=#3b78e2][i]bee[/i][/color] stings?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened to you?!
Howard puts the correct time in and makes popcorn successfully!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I got it!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Awww, I wanted to see fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But we... I mean, Jean-Paul worked so hard on that!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't look so disappointed, twins. Now we have popcorn.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here, $ZOE, I made two gigantic bowls for each of us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, it's kettle corn! You really do know exactly what I like, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And Kay and Kel, here is one gigantic bowl for you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's go watch the movie.
The microwave explodes!
The kitchen fills with smoke until Howard opens a window.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That definitely did not work.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't even recognize the popcorn.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean, now that it's splattered all over the walls?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I meant now that it's all in a misshapen lump of coal that used to be the microwave.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay, Howard. Forget about it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. I can clean this up later. Let's just watch the movie.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And then this one time, Kel and I both got sick, and Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Made you chicken soup! Don't you remember?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, but that's not the story I was trying to tell!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And what story is that?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I wanted to share the story about... Oh, nevermind. I give up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, Howard. Your sisters must really look up to you to tell such great stories.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. I guess they really do.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We like Howard. A whole lot.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, Howard has his uses.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, I know you like talking to $ZOE, but...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And Howard once had this summer job...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...Where he had to dress up as a gigantic hot dog!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, Howard, those stories are... Really embarrassing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. I know.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But to be fair, the twins are stretching some of them...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No, we're not!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: They really happened!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: True or not, you shouldn't tell on your sisters like that.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, I'm sure $ZOE's heard enough about me, so...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Story time is over, twins.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's go inside and make some popcorn.
Howard, $ZOE, and the twins shuffle into the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kay, Kel, you want to go put the popcorn in the microwave?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No, that's okay. It'll be better if you do it, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Popcorn tastes `so` much better when you make it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Popcorn tastes [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much better when you make it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You've never told me that before.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But all right, let's go make popcorn!
Howard, $ZOE, and the twins go into the kitchen. Howard puts a batch of popcorn into the microwave.
The microwave beeps as Howard puts the numbers in, then hums as it starts.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Your sisters are so sweet. They seem to really like to play with you.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh, we `love` to play with Howard. He's the best brother ever. We do all sorts of things to... I mean, `with` him.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, we [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] to play with Howard. He's the best brother ever. We do all sorts of things to... I mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]with[/i][/color] him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Everything's like a big game to you two.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: The popcorn is burning.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? How long has it been in there? I thought I set it to a minute and a half.
Howard sees smoke coming from the microwave and dashes over to find a burnt lump of popcorn.
Howard puts in another bag and presses the buttons, but notices...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Anything wrong, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Someone messed with the microwave! The buttons have been rewired. And I know who did this!
Howard looks at Kay and Kel who smile innocently.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If I out the twins, they might start pulling pranks directly `on` $ZOE instead of behind her back.
nodes.text_bbcode: If I out the twins, they might start pulling pranks directly [color=#e23b3b][i]on[/i][/color] $ZOE instead of behind her back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uhm.... It was... Jean-Paul. He always gets confused in these American houses, so we told him to move around whatever he wants.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess he rewired the microwave buttons as well.
Howard examines the microwave.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, I get it. The numbers are off by two. If I just subtract two to each number I want to put in, it should work.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So if I want to put in 3:45... I should put in 1:23 minutes!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll take care of this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You followed her around? Like, stalked her?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah! He was always waiting by her locker and following her down the school halls.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How do you know all this?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We saw you buying all those flowers to put in her locker every day!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And we found the mushy love poetry you wrote to her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds really embarrassing for everyone, including the twins.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I liked her a lot, but I was kind of shy when she was around.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I'd buy her a flower every day and put it in her locker.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, Howard, you used flowers to tell a girl how you felt about her?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's really cute.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You had to be rescued?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: He dove off the high board and knocked himself unconscious.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, and the lifeguard Rachel had to jump in and save him. Then she kissed him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er, that was really mouth-to-mouth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, jumping from the high board is so dangerous. You could have been seriously hurt.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That wasn't embarrassing, but it definitely wasn't cool.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And when Howard was in junior high, he had a crush on a girl, and he...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My swim trunks fell off when I dove off the high board right when I hit the water.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehehe! That's pretty funny.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: More like embarrassing. I had to swim to the other side wearing nothing at all.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I was actually going to tell the story about Rachel!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Rachel? Who's Rachel?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just the poor lifeguard who had to fish my trunks from the bottom of the pool.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But on the bright side, I made an awesome splash.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, Howard, I'm never brave enough to jump off the high dive.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But forget that story! When Howard was in junior high, he had a crush on a girl, and he...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The twins were so scared when the zombies popped out of their graves that they hid behind the couch.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They refused to watch the movie unless I held their hand through all the intense scenes.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We weren't talking about `that` part.
nodes.text_bbcode: We weren't talking about [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] part.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw, that's so considerate, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But there was another time when we went swimming, and Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He cried throughout the entire movie?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Only when the zombies popped out of their graves. Howard shouted a lot too.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: He screams like a girl!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't know you were so scared of scary movies.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That was when I was much younger.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Howard, that was last year!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did shake a lot during the zombie movie a couple weeks ago...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But there was another time when we went swimming, and Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was just, uh, cleaning up. Minor accident. Nothing to worry about.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't have my date with $ZOE if I look like a mess.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to change really quickly. Stay right here.
Howard dashes into his room, changes clothes, and comes back down to find $ZOE with the twins!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...And he was so embarrassed, he turned red in the face!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Like a tomato!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, poor Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you guys telling $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just some secrets between girls.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess you've already met, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, these are my little sisters Kay and Kel. Twins, this is $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hello, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Hello, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kay and Kel, I've heard so much about how spunky you are, but nothing about how adorable you both are!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Thanks. 'Adorable' runs in the family, you know.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, Howard used to be really cute! Until he grew up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Used` to?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Used[/i][/color] to?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He still has his moments.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Haha. Very funny.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what are the twins doing at home? I thought your mom was taking them somewhere fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She was supposed to, but now I'm stuck baby-sitting.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure your sisters and I will get along just fine. Right, girls?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Right! Oh, $ZOE, we have tons and tons of stories to tell you.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Stories about Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no! I know where this is going. They're going to tell the worst stories about me! I have to stop them!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: One time, we were watching the horror zombie movie 'Nightmare of the Living Undead', and Howard...
Howard puts the trick box into the cardboard box, closes the lid, and runs for cover.
It explodes!
But the box is thick enough to contain the blast.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Howard, we spent the last two weeks making those rotten eggs...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That wasn't too bad. And I've cleared all the traps!
The doorbell rings.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE's here!
Howard grabs the box and makes a speedy dash towards the door...
But it explodes on him, soaking his shirt in rotten eggs.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ugh, gross! This is awful! At least it's the last trap.
The doorbell rings!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no, $ZOE's here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right. One left. Where's the last trap?
Howard looks around and sees a nicely wrapped present on the kitchen counter. It reads 'For $ZOE' on a card on the top.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That would be sweet. If I didn't know it was from the twins.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that box smells `awful`... Like rotten eggs!
nodes.text_bbcode: And that box smells [color=#e23b3b][i]awful[/i][/color]... Like rotten eggs!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, that's one of their patented `Exploding Eggs Boxes!` If I touch that box, it'll burst, rotten eggs and all!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, that's one of their patented [color=#e23b3b][i]Exploding Eggs Boxes![/i][/color] If I touch that box, it'll burst, rotten eggs and all!

nodes.text: Howard sees an empty cardboard box near the trash can.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I could stuff it in a bigger box, so it won't explode everywhere. But maybe I have enough time to grab it and throw it outside.

options.label: Put it in the cardboard box.
Run outside and throw it away.

nodes.text: Howard grabs the honey pot from the kitchen cabinet and flings open the bathroom door.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Go bees!
Howard throws the honey jar outside.
The bees hover around the door, then swarm around Howard.
Howard swats at them and gets stung!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ow! Ow!
Several bee stings later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm glad they bees are gone, but I really hope I'm not allergic.
Howard grabs the flower vase from the center of the kitchen table and flings open the bathroom door.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Go bees!
Howard throws the flowers through the back door, and the bees follow them outside!
Howard closes the back door.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm glad that worked!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: There goes our army of angry bees...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right. Two left. Where's the next trap?
Howard hears a buzzing sound coming from the bathroom door.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kay, Kel? Is that the sound of bees?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We didn't `not` put bees into the bathroom for you or $ZOE to find.
nodes.text_bbcode: We didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] put bees into the bathroom for you or $ZOE to find.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And it's not like they're `not` angry!
nodes.text_bbcode: And it's not like they're [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] angry!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How did you even get them in there? Nevermind. I don't want to know.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just need to get them back out. What are bees attracted to?
Howard sees a jar of honey on the table next to a vase of fragrant flowers.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I should lure them out with...

nodes.prompt: I should lure them out with...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I should lure them out with...

nodes.text: Howard reaches up to the top shelf, his fingers moving the bucket forward...
...And catches it deftly as it falls!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whew! I'm glad that won't be falling onto anyone's head.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Aw, Howard! But that one's a classic...
Howard grabs the rope to cut it, but pulls too hard.
The bucket tips over Howard, soaking him with water!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aghh!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wish I could change...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But $ZOE's more important than squishy shoes and a soggy t-shirt. I have to disarm those traps!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But $ZOE's going to be here any minute. I have to disarm those traps. Where are they?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's a surprise! You wouldn't want to ruin a surprise, would you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If it has anything to do with pranks, of course I do!
Howard looks around and sees a bucket of water on a shelf above the front door with a string attached to the doorknob.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I should...

options.label: Reach up and grab the bucket.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE is my girlfriend, so you girls have to be nice to her, understand?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We'll be so nice in front of her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'In front of her'?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kay, Kel, if you don't behave, I'm going to tell Mom and Dad what really happened to their favorite family Christmas tape.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You wouldn't.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We erased our tracks. No one will ever know the true origin of the My Cute Small Horse TV movie!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And you're too late. We already set up traps all over the house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When did you do that?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: When you were talking to Mom. There are only three. It was easy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great. I knew something like this would happen. At least I didn't bribe them first.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE is my girlfriend, so you girls have to be nice to her, understand?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We'll be so nice in front of her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'In front of her'?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know you two. If you promise to behave and not set up any traps, I'll pay you $5.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Fine. $20.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Each.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! That's just extortion.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: If you want something, you need to make sacrifices.
Howard hands over the money.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard! This money will be perfect for paying for the traps we've set up all over the house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Didn't I just pay you `not` to do that? You take them down right now!
nodes.text_bbcode: Didn't I just pay you [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] to do that? You take them down right now!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You told us not to set up traps at all, but nothing about taking down ones the three that are already there.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, and you paid us the money up front.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We'll never learn if you reward us for good behavior first!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great. Threatening them probably wouldn't have stopped them, but at least I wouldn't have lost $40!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now I just need to straighten up before she comes over.
Howard sees two lumpy bags on the floor and tries to lift them, but they're too heavy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oof! What the...?
Howard unzips the bags... And finds `Kay and Kel!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard unzips the bags... And finds [b]Kay and Kel![/b]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Twins! What are you doing here? You're supposed to be halfway across town by now.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Emergency evacuation Plan C.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: One of your emergency plans was to zip yourself inside gym bags?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: This would be one of the last places Mom would look...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And just how were you planning on getting out of the bags?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It worked out fine, didn't it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why did you run away from Mom and Dad?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Jean-Paul promised us we'd see money. But it turns out, he really meant some dumb painter that makes impressions.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean, `Monet?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]Monet?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We thought it was the French way of saying it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You two aren't supposed to be here. I'm calling Mom and Dad.
Howard picks up the phone.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Howard? Is everything all right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kay and Kel snuck out of your car and came back home! They're in the kitchen right now.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: No, Howard, they're right here. Jean-Paul, aren't the twins sitting right next to you?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: They are, but... They haven't said anything this entire time.
Cathy and Jean-Paul look in the backseat and find wooden dummies instead of the twins!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh dear. I'm sorry, Howard, but we're too far away to turn back around and get them. You'll have to take care of them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But what about my date?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Here, let me talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Howard, there comes a time in every man's life when he has to deal with something he doesn't like.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: This is one of those times. Good-bye!
Howard's dad hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now I have to babysit you two. And $ZOE's coming over in a couple minutes!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We know. We heard you on the phone with her.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And we want to welcome her with a special surprise.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh-oh. The last time the twins had a special surprise, it was unleashing a rabid bear at my pool party.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What should I do to stop the twins from scaring $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nothing fancy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just making popcorn, watching a movie, and enjoying a special gift I picked up for you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know school's been busy for you lately, so I wanted a nice, relaxing date for both of us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard, that sounds perfect. I'll see you then! Bye!
$ZOE hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My parents are gone, so we'll be all by ourselves.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And it'll just be us. The entire day. Alone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got that part...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No one here to bother us while we do exactly what we want.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which is what exactly?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, I don't mind spending time alone with you, but that sounds a little sketchy. What do you think we're going to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like `that.` I mean, it's popcorn, a movie, and a special dessert I picked up for you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't mean it like [color=#e23b3b][i]that.[/i][/color] I mean, it's popcorn, a movie, and a special dessert I picked up for you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, Howard. Now `that` sounds like a perfectly respectable and fun afternoon. I'll be over soon then! Bye!
nodes.text_bbcode: Aww, Howard. Now [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] sounds like a perfectly respectable and fun afternoon. I'll be over soon then! Bye!

nodes.text: $ZOE hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But be careful. I know the twins have set just as many traps as defenses.
A few moments later, the twins load up the plastic catapult and fire colored blobs of gelatin fly at the tree house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Push one of the buttons!
$ZOE pushes a black button with white markings on it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not the one with the skull and crossbones!
A trapdoor opens beneath $ZOE and Howard, and they slide down...
...Into a pit right beneath the tree house!
Howard and $ZOE stand up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What just happened...? Howard, we're trapped down here! The walls are too high to climb!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, up there! Kay? Kel?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: That's Cutebeard and Kelp to you, scallywag!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Get us out of here!

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.text: One fine Saturday afternoon...
Howard's parents, Kay, Kel, and Jean-Paul are sitting in the mini-van for a family trip.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Sure you don't want to come, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. $ZOE's coming over, remember?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, that's right. You have your little house date with her.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: A house date while the parents are out, huh? How romantic. A chance for you to play what you in America call 'tonsil hockey'...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: What?! What exactly is going to happen on this date?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Dear, the twins are sleeping. Keep your voice down.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And I'm sure Howard will act appropriately.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, Dad, it's just popcorn, a romantic movie, and some dessert.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, that sounds lovely. $ZOE seems nice. You know, I'm surprised you don't have her by the house more often.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I would invite her over more... But I'm not sure she's ready to face the twins yet.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know they can sense fear. Linda had a bunch of sisters, so she had no problem pushing back, but $ZOE is so nice... They'll run all over her!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You could be surprised, Howard. She might actually get along just fine with them. But I guess you can save that for a different date.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Anyway, son, we're leaving. Try not to scare this one off like you did the last one.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Dad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Most of it. The structure anyway. Kay and Kel have a very lucrative tree house business because of it.
Howard gestures at the colorful button console, dangling ropes, and various levers around the tree house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But those things I did `not` put in.
nodes.text_bbcode: But those things I did [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] put in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, what is all this stuff?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think they're the twins' traps.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Traps? It's like a fort.
At that moment, a big 'thump' sounds against the side of the house!
Howard glances out the curtain-covered window and looks down where Kay and Kel stand with a plastic catapult.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where did they get a catapult?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Ahoy! We be the fearsome pirates, Cutebeard Kay and Captain Kelp!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Arrr, there be war afoot!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Ye landlubbers have hornswaggled our vessel!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've 'waggled' their what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We've taken their tree house.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Arrr, and if ye don't give it up, we be takin' it back.
Cutebeard Kay fires a shot at the tree house from the catapult.
Water balloons splatter the window, splashing on Howard and $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If this keeps up, the twins are going to overtake us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What should we do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That I couldn't handle them?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They can be a handful. And you're so shy, I just thought...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I used to be really shy and easily intimiated, but I'm not that girl anymore. I can't believe you didn't tell me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, with Linda, they tried to prank her, but she handled them just fine.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I'm not Linda?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Exactly! Er, I mean, that's a `good` thing.
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! Er, I mean, that's a [color=#e23b3b][i]good[/i][/color] thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just forget it, Howard. Your sisters are probably plotting something, and I don't want to be caught off-guard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They're my family, $ZOE. They're pretty rowdy and hard to deal with sometimes, but I wanted you to like them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Also the twins pull me into a lot of their crazy schemes...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So if you didn't like them, our relationship would be very difficult for you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I do like them, Howard. Despite everything.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Despite replacing your favorite dessert with spiders?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least those spiders were fake.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I may not have siblings, but I've babysat before.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't imagine your kids pulling pranks on the scale of what the twins have done. I'm surprised they haven't pranked all of Centerscore by now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha. You might be right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have to talk with them about this one.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll go with you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just be prepared.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's the worst they can do?
Howard walks to the twins' room and knocks on the door.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Twins! We have to talk! I know you ate that dessert, and it was $ZOE's!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Come in!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And look delicious!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Kel, shhhh!
Howard opens the door suspiciously...
...And sees gigantic raccoons spring from cages and run towards the door!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe this!
Howard wheels around, pushing Zoe out the door ahead of him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, run!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Run where?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where can we hide from the twins?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The tree house!
A short time later, in the tree house...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So when you said you called them the 'twin terrors,' you weren't joking, were you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No. Not really. Everyone says their younger siblings are terrors, but Kay and Kel really `are` terrors. Like, run-for-the-hills terrors.
nodes.text_bbcode: No. Not really. Everyone says their younger siblings are terrors, but Kay and Kel really [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] terrors. Like, run-for-the-hills terrors.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I see. Howard, is that the real reason I've never been over to your house before?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. I was afraid that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gourmet? Are you really going to try to make me eat `this`, Howard?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Gourmet? Are you really going to try to make me eat [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color], Howard?!

nodes.text: Howard shakes the box.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: At least they're not live spiders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're dead?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, they're just not real. In fact, they're chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not funny.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And don't you want to tell me why your sisters are pulling all these pranks?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You knew?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I figured it out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The water guns were a good indication.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A practical joke?
Howard shakes the box.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They're not live spiders, at least.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're dead?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, they're just not real. In fact, they're chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not really funny.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know. Look, $ZOE, it's probably better that you know the truth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: About how the twins are pulling pranks on us?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You knew?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I figured it out, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The water guns were a good indication.
Howard and $ZOE go into the kitchen. Howard takes a pink cake box from the refrigerator.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here it is. Your favorite dessert.
Howard hands the box to $ZOE, and $ZOE opens it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is this? Ewww! Gross!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gross?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You bought `these` for me?
nodes.text_bbcode: You bought [color=#3b78e2][i]these[/i][/color] for me?

nodes.text: Howard looks in the box and sees a bunch of small black spiders sitting on the bottom.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The twins! They stole the dessert I bought for $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kay and Kel have done it this time. I'm going to kill them!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But what do I tell $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, $ZOE, that's actually...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That movie looks fun. And it's romantic too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, silly. We're going to watch Gail escape from the evil Queen Narcissa and find her true love, Prince Edgar!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This ended up being a better choice than I thought!
Howard puts an arm around $ZOE, while the twins watch the movie happily.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Everything's better with cute, talking animals!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And princesses that sing!
$ZOE leans over and kisses Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What was that for?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just thought it was sweet that you picked this movie. And that you look out for Kay and Kel so well.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They are my younger sisters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, they don't seem that mischievous at all. I'm surprised.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Surprised?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, you told me horror stories about how they put raccoons in your room and pull pranks on you all the time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought they'd be much worse. I figured that was why you hadn't invited me over to your house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, that. No, there was just no good time until now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, okay. Well, I'm glad to be here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm glad you're here too.
An hour or so later...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: That was a great movie! I liked the singing!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I liked the dragon at the end! I wish we had a pet dragon.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha! You couldn't even keep a pet dog. Especially after you trained it to tackle on command.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Dad recovered from that broken leg eventually.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, $ZOE, you know what's better than a great movie? A great dessert. I bought your favorite.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: `Our` favorite dessert?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Our[/i][/color] favorite dessert?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, twins, I don't have enough for all of us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But we can share, if you like.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But I wanted my own.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's okay, Kel. Thanks, $ZOE, but we don't want any of `that` dessert anyway. We're leaving.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's okay, Kel. Thanks, $ZOE, but we don't want any of [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] dessert anyway. We're leaving.

nodes.text: Kay and Kel leave the room unhappily.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Boo!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: That's a boring movie.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, you don't have to watch it. Don't you have dollhouses to play with or minor countries to take over?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You can't find anything to do that's more interesting than what $ZOE and I are doing?
Kay smiles widely. Too widely.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I can think of some interesting things... Come on, Kel.
Kay and Kel leave the room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you think that was the best thing to choose? They seemed so disappointed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They'll be fine.
Howard and $ZOE settle in for the movie and watch the love story between Ella and Jojo unfold.
Howards puts an arm around $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee. How romantic.

nodes.speaker: Jojo
nodes.text: Ella, the ship is sinking. We'll die if we stay here.

nodes.speaker: Jojo
nodes.text: Get into one of those lifeboats, and save yourself.

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Oh, Jojo, you're the only thing that matters to me. I can't leave you behind.

nodes.speaker: Jojo
nodes.text: All right. Then we'll take our chances with the ocean. Let's get off this ship.
Jojo and Ella run to the side of the ship and jump!
The water rushes towards the heroes and...
$ZOE and Howard feel ice cold water squirt against their backs!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aieee! What was that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That feels like Terf blasters!
Howard and $ZOE turn around to find Kay and Kel running around with gigantic water guns.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You wanted a romantic movie where things get watery, then you can get it.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: At least the watery part!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kay! Kel!
Howard runs after the twins, and they dodge, shooting water at Howard.
The twins shoot their blasters, and Howard ducks, as the twins spray the TV.

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: Buzz... Buzz...
The TV shuts off with one final, emphatic crackle.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great, now the TV's destroyed!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When Dad gets home, you're going to be in so much trouble!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Not if he can't catch us!
Kay and Kel run out of the room.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know what I'm going to do with them. Dad's going to blame me of course.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Howard. We'll deal with it later. Let's just try to enjoy the rest of the afternoon.

options.label: The Ship Everyone Said Would Never Sink.

nodes.text: Howard and $ZOE walk into the den where Kay and Kel are waiting on the sofa.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, big brother. What are we watching?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Since this is my date with $ZOE, `we` are going to watch a romantic movie... 'The Ship Everyone Said Would Never Sink'!
nodes.text_bbcode: Since this is my date with $ZOE, [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] are going to watch a romantic movie... 'The Ship Everyone Said Would Never Sink'!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's my favorite movie of all time.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Blech! There's way too much kissing and zero explosions!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah! The only cool part is the sinking ship.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Howard, what about our favorite movie?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't plan for your favorite. I didn't even know you two were going to be here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't have to watch the movie with us.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But Kay and I want to watch a movie. We have nothing else to do, and that's the only TV in the house.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you girls have any other movies you `would` want to watch?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you girls have any other movies you [color=#3b78e2][i]would[/i][/color] want to watch?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! We want to see 'Entranced'!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's about a cartoon girl that becomes part of the real world.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Can we watch that one instead?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm okay watching either, Howard. It's up to you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A kid's movie? I wanted to watch a romantic movie with $ZOE, not a movie with the twins.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We should watch...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or tried to...
In fact, you were perfect!
The next afternoon at Howard's house...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You girls ready for a snack?
Howard places a very pretty bakery box in the middle of the table.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's a Sparkles bakery box! It must be cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE dropped this off for you guys as a thank-you for yesterday. Isn't she nice?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: That is very nice of her.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: `Too` nice of her.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Too[/i][/color] nice of her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, go ahead, guys. Aren't you going to open it?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Why don't you open it first?
Howard shrugs and opens the box. Nothing happens.
The girls crowd around the box and stare at it in awe.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No fake box top?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No exploding flour bomb? Not even one surprise snake attack?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Unlike you two, $ZOE's not going to prank you. Especially not with real snakes.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey, we gave you the antidote eventually.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Eventually.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Eventually.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Okay, so no tricks so far. But what about the snack?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Ha! She gave us...
Kay reaches in and pulls out two shiny apples.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...Apples?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And there aren't any worms in them?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No, there aren't.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Wait, there's a note inside!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Ha! There's the prank. This is where it all unravels!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: 'Dear Kay and Kel, I had a lot of fun yesterday. Here are some treats for you. Maybe next time, if you're good, they'll be cupcakes! Love, $ZOE'

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: The note wasn't even mean or insulting!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Me neither!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I told you. $ZOE is sweet. No tricks, no pranks... And definitely no extortion or petty theft.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, but Howard, she... She makes us want to be better people!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...Or at least to act much nicer when she's around.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good! Because she's going to be around much more often.
Looks like Howard and $ZOE had the perfect date thanks to you! Thanks for playing!
See you next time!
